== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Dawnwing Sect is an ancient organization that utilizes [[scripts]] and constructs for defense. It was once a well-defended entity, but its protections were eventually destroyed by the [[Stormcallers]], a cult associated with the [[Weeping Dragon]] [[Dreadgod]]. The sect's emblem features spread wings, and its members have been known to wear gray clothing or cloaks bearing this symbol. [[Ziel of the Wasteland]] is a significant figure associated with the group, having served as its [[Archlord]]. His [[Path of the Dawn Oath]] is an offshoot of the [[Path of Last Oath|Path of the Last Oath]]. Though he previously led the sect, he has since acted as a representative for the [[Akura clan]] and the [[Sage of Twin Stars]]. In recent conflicts, [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] has utilized his abilities to create barriers against powerful entities like the [[Bleeding Phoenix]].}}
